project.name: PayFlow EU Merchant Onboarding
project.description: Digital onboarding of small and medium merchants (legal entities) for a payment-acceptance product, including company verification, beneficial ownership, screening and risk rating.

documents.title: Interview - Head of Merchant Sales
documents.masked_text:
Lena: Merchants complain that onboarding takes two weeks.
We need merchants to be live within 24 hours of applying.
Merchants must be able to upload company documents in PDF or image format.
The system should pre-fill company details from the business register using the registration number.
We should not ask small merchants for beneficial owner details because it slows them down.
The onboarding form should be simple and intuitive.
We plan to release new features every sprint because the market moves quickly.

documents.title: Memo - MLRO onboarding requirements
documents.masked_text:
Memo: Merchant onboarding AML requirements
The system must identify and verify all beneficial owners holding 25% or more of the merchant entity.
Every merchant, director and beneficial owner must be screened against EU and UN sanctions lists and PEP databases.
Merchants in high-risk sectors such as gambling or crypto must undergo enhanced due diligence before activation.
Each merchant must receive a risk score that is reviewed at least annually for high-risk merchants.
All onboarding records must be kept for 5 years after the merchant relationship ends.
The system shall allow analysts to file suspicious activity reports to the FIU.

documents.title: DPO review notes
documents.masked_text:
DPO review
Directors' identity document images must be deleted 30 days after verification
only the verification result is kept.
A DPIA must be completed before go-live because biometric face matching is used for directors.
Merchants must be told how their data is used through a privacy notice at the start of onboarding.
Personal data must be stored in EU data centres only.
Automated rejections must be reviewable by a human on request.

documents.title: Platform team constraints
documents.masked_text:
Marco: The onboarding API must respond within 800 ms at the 95th percentile.
The service must be available 99.95% of the time.
All admin users must authenticate with MFA and access must be role-based.
Every change to a merchant's risk score must be written to an audit log.
